dispute_ticket.description: I was inside Tampines Mall and came down as soon as I saw the driver's message. The driver cancelled and charged me $8.00 even though I was only a few minutes late. Please refund the fee.

chat_logs.content: I'm at Entrance B, white Corolla.
Coming down now, in the lift at level 3.
Trip cancelled by driver. Reason: rider_no_show. Cancellation fee of $8.00 applied.

app_events.details: Rider R-7101 booked trip RYDE-F2-001 from Tampines Mall to Changi Airport T2. Pickup 10:00.
Driver D-8201 (Lim Kok Wei, Toyota Corolla Altis SKV 3321 B) assigned. ETA 9 min.
Driver pressed I'm Here at pickup point. Geofence check passed (driver within 30 m of pickup).
Driver app lost GPS signal from 10:04:10 to 10:06:50 (160 s). Cause logged: basement car park.
$8.00 cancellation fee charged to rider payment method (credit card).

free_wait_time_min.text: Minutes the driver must wait at the pickup point, counted from arrival, before any waiting or cancellation fee may apply to the rider.

cancellation_fee_after_wait.text: The fee in SGD charged to the rider when a booking is cancelled after the driver has waited past the free waiting time. It covers rider cancellations and rider no-shows, including the no-show cancellation the driver presses after waiting past the threshold; it does not cover a cancellation the driver makes for the driver's own reasons.

no_show_threshold_min.text: Minutes the driver must wait at the pickup point, counted from arrival, before the rider counts as a no-show. A wait of exactly this many minutes counts as a no-show (the limit is inclusive).

fee_goes_to.text: Says who receives a cancellation or no-show fee once it is charged. It governs where the money goes, not whether the fee is due.

free_cancellation_within_min_of_match.text: Minutes after the driver is matched during which the rider may cancel without a fee. It governs rider cancellations only.

expected_outcome.reason: The driver_arrived event (10:02:00, geofence check passed) and the GPS fixes at 10:02:00 and 10:08:00 at the pickup point put the driver at the pickup from 10:02:00. The cancellation at 10:10:30 is 8.5 minutes later, which is at or past this trip's 8-minute no-show threshold. The rider's own message at 10:09 says she was still in the lift. The GPS dropout from 10:04:10 to 10:06:50 falls inside the wait but does not matter: the clean driver_arrived event and the clean fixes either side of it settle the arrival and the wait. The S$8.00 fee stands.
